packageRules.description: Non-major updates merge themselves once the required checks pass
LiveKit (client, server SDK, SFU) must move together and be tested by hand: own group, never automerged
The docs site's framework moves as one (Starlight pins its Astro peer) and Starlight is 0.x, so a minor can break the build; the docs CI job is not a required check, so the group is merged by hand
solid-js follows OpenTUI's exact peer and is never bumped alone; OpenTUI is 0.x so a minor can break, and the terminal smokes are not part of the required test job, so the group is merged by hand
Bumps in versions.json: the downloaded ones stay red until `bun scripts/versions.ts refresh`, the Caddy recipe needs the image job green; neither automerges or blocks the allNonMajor group
The SignPath action holds the signing token and returns the files that ship: pinned to a commit, every bump reviewed by hand
The Dockerfile (its golang and bun images too) and compose.yml ship in the image or the release tag, so their bumps must cut a release
versions.json pins the binaries baked into the image, so its bumps must cut a release
